> LSJ,
> Could for example, Enkidu rush a minion, get blocked by a minion with 3
> blood, hit the minion with hands, Blur, Play Form of Mist and then Play
> Pulled Fangs to continue the action while sending the blocker to torpor?
>

I guess so. problem is that, once you hit them into torpor with Enkidu's
Strenght you can't play blur and FoM anymore. so the above combo only works
optimal on vamps who have exactly 3 or 6 blood on them. And then only if the
other vamp cannot use a blood for a combat card (wich they will try, if
they've seen the combo)

I tried using a similar thing a couple of years ago. with a magnum. rush
the main vamp, get blocked, shoot twice and play Form of mist. But I ran
into the same problem: you cannot torporise the blocker before playing FoM.
Pulled Fangs can help, but only if the other vamp is empty.
